notes: MegaLabel uses FontType.Regular locale substitution. Authored English Spectral/Kreon Bold labels therefore select Chinese Noto Regular unless a business method subsequently overrides the font.
The event option title is an explicit rich [b] span, so its Chinese face remains Source Han Bold. Normal event and merchant prose remains regular; rich bold spans use the explicit bold face.

Event option auto fitting stops at 4 native pixels. Original source allows 12 through 24 at desktop scale; the full existing event reader remains available if the calculator floor still truncates a label.

Dynamic formatted event fields include numeric values and prepared card, relic, potion or character titles; collect those existing localized title alphabets, not fallback model IDs. No original localized text belongs in this metadata file.
